newsitem.title: SPAIN: Palma cargo traffic ahead of 1995 in October.
newsitem.headline: Palma cargo traffic ahead of 1995 in October.

text.p: Cargo traffic at Spain's Palma de Mallorca airport, the main gateway to the Balearic Islands, was slightly lower at 1,920 tonnes in October from 1,945 tonnes in September, but up 21 percent over October 1995, figures from the airport authority show.
Nearly 83 percent of the total was national traffic, 15 percent intra-European Union business and just over two percent was other international freight.
The accumulated total so far this year now stands at 16,407 tonnes, 14 percent ahead of the same period last year.
The airport also handled 144 tonnes of mail in the month and 1.49 million passengers. -- Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
